actual_scope: Audit one fractional JSON label coordinate through the selected bit checker and record exporter; enforce literal integer labels in an opt-in successor.
scope_change_reason: PR2992 and PR3004 already cover the duplicate-scatter handoff. This allowed variation audits a distinct acceptance implication: int coercion in Word.__init__ versus raw Fraction coordinates in the exporter.
bottleneck_link: Source-to-export geometry agreement is required before symbolic supplier evidence can support physical frame dimensions and costs. This is a reliability result, not a new kappa.
stop_rule: One fixed coordinate mutant and integer baseline/control; check exact frame ranks and both operational entry modes. No full native/selected replay or further supplier search.
evidence: RESULT.json, verify.py and eight behavioral test groups in test_boundary.py. Direct and registered replay details are in README.md.
